title: Process Separators
summary: Custom gas-liquid and liquid-liquid separator vessels with duty-specific internals and instrumentation interfaces.
body:
Tongyang fabricates process separation vessels for specified flow rates, compositions and operating conditions. Separator dimensions and internals depend on the required separation objective, allowable carryover and the properties of all relevant phases.

Typical applications

  • Gas-liquid knock-out and flash drums
  • Two-phase and selected three-phase separation service
  • Liquid-liquid separation and oil-water duties
  • Separators integrated with piping, instruments and skid packages when agreed

Key technical parameters for quotation

  • Feed: normal/min/max flow, phases, gas/liquid densities and viscosities
  • Performance: required separation efficiency, droplet/particle criteria, allowable carryover and pressure drop
  • Conditions: operating/design pressure and temperature, corrosive constituents and solids load
  • Configuration: horizontal/vertical preference, holdup time, liquid-level requirements and drainage
  • Scope: inlet device, demister/coalescer, baffles, instrumentation nozzles, valves and skid requirements

Mechanical fabrication & standards

Vessel construction, materials, welding, NDE and pressure testing are specified against the applicable mechanical design code. Internal separation features are selected or manufactured according to the approved process basis; process sizing and guaranteed performance are subject to separately confirmed engineering responsibilities.

Quotation basis: a PFD, process data sheet or stream table helps establish a realistic preliminary scope. The final vessel and internal arrangement require technical review.
seoDescription: Custom process separators and separation vessels for industrial gas and liquid services.
